disposition_reason: Plant stress physiology study; selenium was an amendment and no selenium concentrations in plants or food were measured.

study.design: pot experiment with mung bean genotypes under 30 mg/kg arsenic stress, comparing biochar, arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi and selenium (15 mg/kg) soil amendments

non_numeric_findings: Selenium applied to soil at 15 mg/kg as a stress relief treatment under 30 mg/kg arsenic (Methods).
Catalase activity rose and proline fell with biochar, mycorrhizal fungi and selenium treatments compared with arsenic-only control (Abstract).
